author: Bobby Grayson
description: Earlier I predicted FIFO would be needed for liveness. The deadlock-freedom proof went through with Inv alone. The invariant's a+qn=w equation absorbs message reordering. Bounded waiting (a queued client is granted within k releases) is where queue order and hence FIFO would enter.
title: For this protocol FIFO is not needed for safety or deadlock freedom. It would only matter for a fairness argument (bounded waiting), which needs a ranking function and a fair scheduler. Step.prefix exists but is unused by any example
